Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR makes SQLite SDK deprecation warnings specific to each method and aligns diagnostics and migration guidance with the existing retirement deadline. **Example:** Plugin example-plugin calls SessionManager.appendCustomEntry and then SessionManager.appendSessionInfo. - **Before:** The first warning consumes the session-persistence family budget and hides the second migration. - **After:** Each method warns once per plugin per process and names its awaited replacement. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Useful owner-approved direction with integration-test support, but introduced diagnostic leakage and confirmed test failures prevent a clean verdict. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored diagnostic change is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; supplied validation consists of focused tests and CI, and the extracted native authority implementations preserve their checks. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 2 actionable review findings remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Plugin authors can miss required migrations because one deprecated method hides another's warning, and some guidance names unavailable replacements. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction improves an already approved migration program without removing APIs or changing the deadline. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 2 items remain** Keep this maintainer-authored PR open: the migration improvement is useful, but supported host operations now emit misleading warnings and two existing tests retain incompatible expectations. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f` ## Before merge - [ ] **Keep supported host authority reads off the warning adapter (P2)** - The new unconditional warning also runs when createRuntimeSandbox calls this getter for resolveWorkspaceAuthority and prepareWorkspaceAuthority's current-authority assertion, and when Talk prepares control authority. Those supported operations therefore report deprecated plugin usage even when the caller selected an awaited API; under Node's --throw-deprecation the warning can terminate the process. Route these internal reads through the existing non-warning owner while preserving their synchronous final-authority checks, and keep the warning on the public legacy adapter. - [ ] **Update the remaining family-budget test expectations (P2)** - Adding the method to this key changes existing binding and TTS diagnostic contracts, but their tests still require one warning per family. Exact-head CI confirms session-binding-service.async-read.test.ts:194 receives three warnings instead of one, and tts-preferences.worker.test.ts:140 receives two instead of one. Update those tests to assert each expected method and deduplication across repeated calls, retaining their quiet awaited-path assertions. ## Findings - [P2] Keep supported host authority reads off the warning adapter — `src/plugins/runtime/runtime-agent.ts:85-89` - [P2] Update the remaining family-budget test expectations — `src/plugins/sdk-deprecation.ts:98-102` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: No shipped CLI or Gateway trace demonstrates the changed diagnostics, and no explicit base-fail/head-pass run is supplied.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Plugin SDK adapters and session runtime facades feed legacy API calls into a shared diagnostic owner, which records plugin usage and emits migration warnings before delegating to existing implementations. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Plugin or host caller] --> B[Runtime and SDK adapters] B --> C[Deprecation diagnostic owner] C --> D[Per plugin and method budget] D --> E[Migration warning] B --> F[Existing session and storage owners] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep per-method diagnostics on public legacy adapters while supported host operations use the existing owners without misleading warnings. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current main's plugin/family-only key demonstrably suppresses a second method's warning; source tracing also establishes the introduced host-warning path, without executing target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The shared per-method budget is an appropriate fix, but warning placement must distinguish public legacy use from supported host delegation and affected diagnostic tests must follow the new contract. Full review comments: - [P2] Keep supported host authority reads off the warning adapter — `src/plugins/runtime/runtime-agent.ts:85-89` The new unconditional warning also runs when createRuntimeSandbox calls this getter for resolveWorkspaceAuthority and prepareWorkspaceAuthority's current-authority assertion, and when Talk prepares control authority. Those supported operations therefore report deprecated plugin usage even when the caller selected an awaited API; under Node's --throw-deprecation the warning can terminate the process. Route these internal reads through the existing non-warning owner while preserving their synchronous final-authority checks, and keep the warning on the public legacy adapter. Confidence: 0.99 - [P2] Update the remaining family-budget test expectations — `src/plugins/sdk-deprecation.ts:98-102` Adding the method to this key changes existing binding and TTS diagnostic contracts, but their tests still require one warning per family. Exact-head CI confirms session-binding-service.async-read.test.ts:194 receives three warnings instead of one, and tts-preferences.worker.test.ts:140 receives two instead of one. Update those tests to assert each expected method and deduplication across repeated calls, retaining their quiet awaited-path assertions. Confidence: 1 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.96 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [25933024a1e1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25933024a1e197fa1a503e84b573a47203fc674f). ### Provenance checked - `Shared warning budget` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (7924f12c75f5e5208a52432583000ed772616b22: Deduplicate legacy persistence warnings across source imports, SDK bundles, capability families, and plugin reloads.) - `Retirement annotations and migration documentation` keeps the original intent (418f32e2468b2fac5686b501d6359501949cc964: Preserve released synchronous contracts through the approved December deadline and provide awaited migration paths.) - `Native binding authority delegation` keeps the original intent (283d5e6fe371725484cd316151051b977b2c5a66: Prevent stale native sessions from mutating successors by preserving initiating lineage and checking current authority at effects.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduction and current main:** The introduced diff changes warning deduplication from plugin/family to plugin/family/method for dated SQLite families; fetched main still uses the family-only key. ([`src/plugins/sdk-deprecation.ts:98`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f/src/plugins/sdk-deprecation.ts#L98), [d1e30529c2c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f)) - **Supported host callers reach the new warning:** createRuntimeSandbox uses the warned getter both for resolveWorkspaceAuthority and for prepareWorkspaceAuthority's current-authority assertion; Talk control also calls it directly. This independently confirms the earlier automated review's host-caller concern. ([`src/plugins/runtime/index.ts:213`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f/src/plugins/runtime/index.ts#L213), [d1e30529c2c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f)) - **Diff-caused warning assertion failures:** Exact-head CI annotations report three warnings where the binding test expects one, and two warnings where the TTS test expects one; source confirms both expectations still assume family-wide suppression. ([`src/infra/outbound/session-binding-service.async-read.test.ts:194`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f/src/infra/outbound/session-binding-service.async-read.test.ts#L194), [d1e30529c2c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f)) - **Other checks remain unclassified:** The model-runtime shard fails a registry-fork count assertion at runtime-llm.prepared-owner.test.ts:923; no head-versus-base evidence establishes its cause. The PR context check also fails. Neither is attributed to the patch. Full job logs redirect to a host blocked by this environment. ([`src/plugins/runtime/runtime-llm.prepared-owner.test.ts:923`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f/src/plugins/runtime/runtime-llm.prepared-owner.test.ts#L923), [d1e30529c2c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f)) - **Existing retirement decision:** The SDK policy and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171775 already approve the December 31 compatibility deadline and January stable removal; this PR preserves that decision and corrects migration guidance. ([`src/plugin-sdk/AGENTS.md:75`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f/src/plugin-sdk/AGENTS.md#L75), [d1e30529c2c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1e30529c2c9a29fc4d3cd576e5a8daaf5b7f22f)) - **Provider-removal concern predates this patch:** The base unregisterProvider already delegates to refresh, which emits a deprecation warning for disk-backed catalogs; the existing review's warning-on-supported-extension concern therefore does not establish a newly introduced regression for registered providers. ([`src/agents/sessions/model-registry.ts:864`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7034ca42b491cbfed987e8b232ae6abf0bb9e6d4/src/agents/sessions/model-registry.ts#L864), [7034ca42b491](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7034ca42b491cbfed987e8b232ae6abf0bb9e6d4)) ### PR surface Source +102, Tests +222, Docs +26. Total +350 across 65 files. Added test files: 0.

### Labels Label changes: - add `P2`: Useful SDK migration diagnostics need focused corrections before merge; no urgent production incident is established. - add `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: New public runtime warnings also reach supported host authority operations and can terminate processes configured with --throw-deprecation. - add `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`: Overall readiness is 🦪 silver shellfish; proof is 🦐 gold shrimp and patch quality is 🦪 silver shellfish. - add `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. Label justifications: - `P2`: Useful SDK migration diagnostics need focused corrections before merge; no urgent production incident is established. - `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: New public runtime warnings also reach supported host authority operations and can terminate processes configured with --throw-deprecation. - `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`: Overall readiness is 🦪 silver shellfish; proof is 🦐 gold shrimp and patch quality is 🦪 silver shellfish. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired.
_Reviewed October 16, 2026, 9:14 PM ET / October 17, 2026, 01:14 UTC._

Reviewed the automated comments against the current source. Remaining lower-priority follow-ups are retained under the requested two-round review limit:

- Runtime sandbox/Talk and synchronous keyed-store callers still need their owners' prepared authority replacements. ACP abort also needs its owner to preserve cancellation ordering. These callers can now expose deprecation warnings during host operation; strict `--throw-deprecation` treats such warnings as errors. No silent synchronous bypass is added merely to suppress that signal.
- The disk-backed `ExtensionAPI.unregisterProvider` adapter needs an async-capable extension contract or an owner-directed migration. The direct ModelRegistry diagnostic names its existing async method, which the extension adapter does not itself expose.
- The legacy iMessage factory can also produce the generic factory's once-per-method warning. Consolidating that diagnostic is a follow-up; no extra SQL or state mutation is introduced by either warning.

These are documented limitations, not claims that every bundled caller is already migrated. Credential, execution, external-send and cross-user authority checks remain intact. No early removal is included.
